verdict.rationale: Polar documents a dedicated sandbox server that is completely isolated from production. It supports unlimited test accounts and organizations, end-to-end checkout with Stripe test cards, and is meant for working on integrations without real money or touching the live organization. For the AI-native angle, a separate sandbox MCP endpoint (mcp.polar.sh/mcp/polar-sandbox) lets agents work against sandbox data rather than production. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and sandbox MCP behave as documented.
